business_scope.primary_industry_name: International Air Freight Forwarding and Cargo Aircraft Charter

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia–United States Trade Promotion Agreement (in force 2012; Chapter 10 investment protections)
Colombia–European Union Trade Agreement (in force 2013; investment and trade in services provisions)
Colombia–United Kingdom Double Taxation Agreement (income and capital gains)
Colombia–South Korea Free Trade Agreement (investment provisions)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 526 de 1999 (creates UIAF); Ley 1121 de 2006 (prevention of money laundering and terrorist financing); Ley 599 de 2000 Código Penal arts. 323 et seq.; Ley 1258 de 2008 (S.A.S.); Ley 2195 de 2022 (creates Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales - RUB); Decreto 596 de 2024 (regulatory development of RUB); Circular Externa 026 de 2008 de la Superintendencia de Sociedades; Circular Básica Jurídica 029 de 2014 de la Superintendencia de Sociedades; DIAN General Dispositions on the Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Legal Existence and Representation (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal) of each foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Cámara de Comercio or equivalent corporate registry of the foreign shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if the issuing jurisdiction is a party to the Hague Convention; otherwise consular legalization through the Colombian consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Special Power of Attorney (Poder Especial) granted for the Colombian incorporation process
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the foreign jurisdiction or a Colombian notary if executed in Colombia
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization followed by Hague Apostille or consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing, registry extract, or financial capacity evidence of each ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate registry, statutory auditor, or registered public accountant of the home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization as required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified notarial copies of the passport or national identity document of each shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or civil registry authority of the home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization with Hague Apostille or consular legalization, subject to Colombian documentary exceptions for resident parties

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced PEP screening against the Colombian Procuraduría, Contraloría, and Fiscalía registers; OFAC SDN List; United Nations Security Council Consolidated List; European Union Consolidated Financial Sanctions List; UIAF financial-terrorism designations and local platform lists. Screening must cover the corporate entity, all shareholders, officers, and ultimate beneficial owners at onboarding and continuously thereafter. The medium-risk air cargo charter brokerage profile requires enhanced due diligence, including source-of-wealth checks, adverse-media review, and ongoing wire transfer counterparty screening.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) - https://www.rues.org.co/
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be registered using Spanish-language orthography or a phonetically faithful transliteration into Roman letters. The registered name must include the 'S.A.S.' suffix or the full phrase 'Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada'. Names that are identical or phonetically or graphically confusingly similar to an existing registered name are prohibited. Foreign-language names must be accompanied by a Spanish transliteration where required by the attending Chamber of Commerce.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the name reservation is rejected, the applicant must file a reconsideration petition ('recurso de reposición') before the same Chamber of Commerce within 10 business days of notification. If the rejection persists, an appeal ('recurso de apelación') may be lodged with the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio under Ley 1437 de 2011. Failing resolution within 15 business days, the applicant may resubmit or request administrative silence relief. Formal legal challenge before the Contentious Administrative Jurisdiction is available after exhaustion of the administrative path.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Partially permitted. A virtual office can satisfy the registered corporate seat for S.A.S. formation and commercial registry, but the air cargo charter brokerage operation requires a functional address or local establishment for the statutory operating license, customs brokerage authorization, and DIAN tax registration. A purely virtual arrangement without operational substance will create material regulatory non-compliance risk.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Medium-high; approximately 45% probability during the first 12 months of licensing and operations, driven by unannounced inspections by DIAN customs authorities, the Superintendencia de Transporte, and SARLAFT compliance reviewers. Inspections may verify physical office existence, records, employee presence, and transactional files.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Arts. 1-49; Código de Comercio, Arts. 110-413; Decreto 1074 de 2015 (Registro Mercantil and administrative simplification).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio principal (Registro Mercantil); Superintendencia de Sociedades for post-incorporation oversight.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento privado de constitución (or escritura pública when real property is contributed) filed with the Registro Mercantil.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital. The S.A.S. may be incorporated with at least one subscribed and paid share. If capital is payable in installments, the unpaid balance must be paid within two years. No escrow account is required for ordinary non-banking corporations.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION NO. 001 OF THE FOUNDER/DIRECTORS OF [ENTITY] S.A.S. The undersigned sole founder, by unanimous written consent, resolves: (1) Share Subscription — the subscription and payment of the authorized paid-up shares is accepted, complying with Ley 1258 de 2008. (2) Registered Office — the principal place of business stated in the articles of incorporation is adopted; corporate books shall be kept there. (3) Officers — the legal representative, general manager, and AML compliance officer are appointed with powers to represent the company. (4) Authorizations — the legal representative is authorized to complete tax, registry, licensing, and banking filings. Adopted in [City], [date].

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio principal (Registro Mercantil)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit up to three proposed corporate names through the Chamber of Commerce online portal. The registry verifies that the requested S.A.S. name is distinctive, not confusingly similar to an existing company, and suitable for the business purpose. Obtain the Certificado de Homonimia.
required_dossiers: Application for name approval
Identification document of the applicant
Power of attorney if filed by a representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected or confused with an existing entity, file a rectification or resubmit alternative names for a new availability search before the applicable registry deadline.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Constitutive Document and Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio or Notaría Pública if public deed is used
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the private constitutive document in accordance with Ley 1258 de 2008. All shareholders or their legal representatives must execute the document with authenticated signatures. The articles must include corporate name, object, capital structure, registered office, board composition, officer powers, dispute resolution mechanisms, and fiscal clauses.
required_dossiers: Draft articles of incorporation
Shareholders' valid passports or government-issued IDs
Power of attorney from each non-resident shareholder
Certificate of legal existence if a shareholder is an entity
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct the executed document by mutual consent of shareholders and refile the corrective deed or private document before the Chamber of Commerce. The notary, if used, may issue a certified correction.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registro Mercantil and Issuance of Certificate of Legal Existence
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio principal (Registro Mercantil)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed constitutive document, pre-registration forms, and payment receipt. The Chamber of Commerce reviews the filing, opens the corporate registry folio, and issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal. This certificate is the official evidence of legal existence and officer powers.
required_dossiers: Executed constitutive document
Registration form duly signed
Receipt or proof of payment of registry fees
Officer acceptance letters
Pre-registration tax data if already requested
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry queries missing documents or legal defects, submit the requested corrective instruments within the registry's cure period. If the certificate is not issued due to pending fees, pay the assessed tariff and request expedited issuance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN – Unidad Administrativa Especial Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company in the Registro Único Tributario through DIAN's virtual platform. Obtain the NIT, select the applicable tax regime, and request the electronic invoicing authorization. The legal representative must also request the digital certificate for electronic signature.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Identification of the legal representative
Proof of the registered office address
Bank confirmation or lease agreement for the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rectify the RUT via DIAN's virtual platform if data is incorrect. In case of a blocked filing, an authorized agent can file Formulario 2361 or request DIAN reconsideration with supporting documentation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Bank Account and AML Onboarding
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank authorized by Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate bank account supporting Swift wire and Fedwire payment rails. Present the certified company existence, tax registration, first board resolution, ultimate beneficial owner declarations, and sanctions screening documentation. Maintain enhanced due diligence documentation due to the air-cargo charter broker risk profile.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
RUT and NIT confirmation
First board resolution appointing signatories
Ultimate Beneficial Owner declaration
Board resolution defining account signatory limits
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the application under AML rules, submit additional evidence of legitimate business activity, updated corporate records, and enhanced background documentation. If still unresolved, apply through a regulated FX payment intermediary or alternative financial institution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Employer Registration and Labor Risk Affiliation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administradora de Riesgos Laborales (ARL) and social security operators
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company as an employer before hiring any personnel. Affiliate employees to the social security system, including health, pension, and occupational risk insurance. File the internal workplace safety regulations and emergency response plans required by the Ministry of Labor.
required_dossiers: RUT
Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Employer registration forms
Employee identification documents
Workplace safety committee minutes where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Use the integrated social security planilla correction facility before monthly deadlines. If an employer is not affiliated, present proof of prior filing and request automatic correction to avoid labor and administrative penalties.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Transporte – Dirección de Transporte y Logística; Superintendencia de Puertos y Transporte; for flight operations requiring an air operator certificate, Unidad Administrativa Especial de Aeronáutica Civil (Aerocivil).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registro Nacional de Agencias de Carga Internacional y Certificado de Habilitación para Agencias de Carga Aérea / Charter Broker Authorization; where actual charter flight operations are performed, additionally an air cargo operating permit from Aerocivil.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) – Ministerio de Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category III / exempt for a pure cargo brokerage or charter brokerage office with no physical handling, fueling, ramp storage, or enclosed cargo sorting; mandatory Full EIA if ground handling, warehousing, fuel storage, or cargo terminal operations are conducted.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Air emissions: Resolution 909 of 2008 and Decree 1076 of 2015 for stationary point sources; wastewater: Resolution 0631 of 2015 for sewer discharges; hazardous waste: Decree 4741 of 2005. A non-physical charter broker is not subject to fixed-source discharge thresholds unless it expands into physical cargo handling.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety inspection and certificate from Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos for the registered office; structural load inspection certificate for any mezzanine, storage area, or ramp operation; occupational health and safety clearance from the ARL and Secretaría de Salud; airport operator security access clearance for airside personnel.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) – official portal: www.dian.gov.co
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity must first obtain a local tax representative or appoint a legal representative resident in Colombia, then register through DIAN's online portal (Museo Virtual / PIDE) to obtain the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) and the Número de Identificación Tributaria (NIT). The registration requires documentary proof of the company's existence, power of attorney, and the representative's identification. The RUT is the single tax identification document for all tax, customs, and exchange purposes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia does not provide a check-the-box election; all SAS entities are treated as separate taxable persons. However, certain hybrid mismatch rules and group taxation (consolidation) electable in limited circumstances may apply. A SAS may choose to operate under the standard corporate income tax regime without pass-through eligibility.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA (Impuesto sobre las Ventas / Value Added Tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general turnover threshold for corporations; every legal entity, including SAS, must register for IVA purposes through the RUT before commencing any taxable activity. Natural persons under the simplified regime may have a threshold, but corporate entities are always registered.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Colombia operates a mandatory electronic invoicing (Facturación Electrónica) system administered by DIAN. All IVA-registered taxpayers must issue invoices through DIAN-authorized technological providers or DIAN's free invoicing application. Invoices must be transmitted in near-real-time using XML/CUFE/CUDE formats, include a QR code and digital signature, and comply with the API technical integration requirements. Customs and export documentation must also be processed through DIAN's electronic systems.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods and certain international services are zero-rated (0% IVA). To qualify, the taxpayer must be an IVA-registered exporter, evidence the actual departure of goods from Colombian customs territory (or the provision of services used exclusively abroad), and file the corresponding export declaration with DIAN and the customs authority. For air cargo charter brokerage services, the service must be performed for overseas principals or related to goods destined for export.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Air Waybill (issued by the carrier)
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Reintegro de Divisas)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN maintains strict audit scrutiny over export zero-rating claims. If the export documentation or foreign-currency repatriation requirements are not satisfied or are found fraudulent, DIAN may retroactively claw back all IVA credits claimed, impose fines of up to 200% of the evaded tax, apply default interest, and refer the matter for criminal prosecution for tax fraud. The limitation period for DIAN assessments is generally five years from the date the tax return was filed.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Central Bank of Colombia), jointly with the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (Financial Superintendency) as prudential regulator and the Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales - DIAN (National Tax and Customs Directorate) as exchange-control administrator; the regulated foreign exchange market (mercado cambiario) may only operate through locally authorized intermediaries.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian peso (COP) is fully convertible for current-account transactions including trade in services, royalties, interest, dividends, and cross-border broker commissions; Colombia operates a unified free-exchange regime without separate capital/current-account convertibility tiers. Profit remittances are freely permitted after Colombian-source withholding taxes are settled (dividend remittance WHT at the general 5% rate for non-residents under applicable treaty/domestic rules, plus any additional surtaxes per Law 2277 of 2022), and no prior central-bank authorization is required provided the proceeds are channeled through an authorized intermediary and the underlying foreign investment is duly registered. Capital-account entries (equity injections, loans, guarantees) require registration with Banco de la República via the applicable foreign-exchange declaration forms (e.g., Formulario 3 for international investment); currency convertibility is not rationed or restricted by exchange controls.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender ratio and no compulsory conversion percentage (0%); exporters may lawfully retain and hold foreign currency. However, 100% of export proceeds arising from goods and services, including air cargo charter brokerage commissions, must be channeled through Colombia's regulated foreign-exchange market within statutory deadlines: for goods, within 6 months from the date of the export declaration; for services, within 6 months from the date the service is performed or the payment obligation accrues; extensions are subject to Banco de la República authorization. Valid channeling methods are (i) sale of the foreign currency to an authorized intermediary, (ii) deposit into a foreign-currency bank account maintained in Colombia, or (iii) application against authorized foreign-currency obligations; each operation must be evidenced by the corresponding exchange declaration (Formulario 1 for exports of goods/services).

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational Account (COP current account and foreign-currency account)
Capital Escrow Account / Operational Account (COP current account and foreign-currency account)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW as a primary corporate treasury rail; MEDIUM only as an ancillary collection arrangement. Foreign digital EMI/neobanks (Wise, Payoneer, Mercury, Revolut Business) are not authorized intermediaries of Colombia's regulated foreign-exchange market; routing export proceeds, trade settlements, or capital injections through such entities instead of a Colombian authorized intermediary constitutes an exchange-control infraction (Decree 1730 of 1991, External Resolution 1 of 2018) and may result in fines imposed by DIAN/Banco de la República. These EMIs also cannot issue the Formulario 3 registration for foreign direct investment or provide TRM-referenced COP conversion certificates. Colombian native digital banks (Lulo Bank, Nu Colombia, and Bancolombia's digital corporate onboarding) may serve remote account-opening needs, but all statutory FX channeling and cross-border clearing must remain with tier-1 authorized intermediaries.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory in-person KYC interview: under SARLAFT (Colombian AML/CFT system) and each bank's internal risk policy, the legal representative of a new corporate client must attend a physical branch interview presenting original constitutional documents (documento privado de constitución of the S.A.S.), Certificado de Cámara de Comercio (issued not more than 30 days before), RUT (registro único tributario), valid corporate resolutions appointing signatories, and certified government-issued passports/national IDs. For an ISIC 5229 air cargo charter broker classified as Medium-Risk/Enhanced, physical presence is effectively mandatory; remote video onboarding is not accepted as a substitute for the full SARLAFT interview. At least one director or shareholder holding 10% or more of the equity must appear personally or provide a notarized special power of attorney (poder especial) to a local resident who will attend on their behalf.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity cross-border settlements to foreign air carriers, charter operators, and overseas brokers without a documented beneficial-ownership chain or underlying commercial file.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete transaction file comprising: signed charter party and brokerage agreements; operator air operator certificates (AOCs) and IATA cargo agency credentials (CASS accounts); airway bill (AWB) registry listing shipment details; end-to-end beneficial-ownership declarations up to natural persons; counterparty KYC packs (registry excerpts, passports/bylaws, operating licenses); sanctions/PEP screening reports; commercial invoices and proforma invoices; and the Colombian foreign-exchange declaration (Formulario 1) proving lawful channeling of related proceeds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-funds scrutiny triggered by the initial USD capital injection from non-resident shareholders into the newly formed Colombian S.A.S.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized minutes of the capital increase and paid-in capital certificate (capital pagado); investor's bank statements for the preceding 6 months; Formulario 3 foreign-investment registration and the foreign-investment certificate issued by Banco de la República; inbound SWIFT MT103 with the exact FDI purpose code; investor corporate resolution authorizing the injection; certified copies of investor identification; and a notarized affidavit of legitimate source of wealth and funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Charter/cargo operations involving counterparties domiciled in high-risk, sanctioned, or FATF-listed jurisdictions, or transactions structured with unusual split payments or layered intermediaries.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Enhanced due-diligence package including FATF/GAFI country-risk assessment memo; 100% UBO chain exposure for all contracting parties; cargo manifest and customs/trade compliance certification (export/import licenses if applicable); UN Sanctions and OFAC/BCE interdiction screening certificates; completed bank-provided customer due-diligence questionnaire; contractual commission clauses validating economic purpose; and copies of all regulatory licenses (Civil Aviation Authority cargo agency permit, if applicable).

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing protocol: (i) the non-resident investor wires USD from its own bank account to the S.A.S.'s segregated capital-escrow account at a Colombian authorized intermediary (Bancolombia/Banco de Bogotá) via SWIFT MT103, clearly stating 'Foreign Direct Investment in Colombian Company' as the purpose; (ii) the receiving bank registers the operation with Banco de la República on Formulario 3 (Declaración de cambio por inversión internacional) and obtains the unique FDI registration code; (iii) if COP funding is required, conversion is executed at the TRM (Tasa Representativa del Mercado) with the authorized intermediary only; (iv) the funds must be effectively paid into the local account within the channeling term applicable to capital-account operations; (v) the bank issues the foreign-investment registration certificate, which must be preserved for later profit-repatriation and capital-reduction filings (Formulario 6 for dividend/profit remittances). No inbound capital may be received via unregistered foreign fintech rails, digital EMIs, or third-party pass-through accounts.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rails for trade settlements: (i) SWIFT MT103 international wire transfers for charter-hire payments and brokerage commissions to foreign carriers/agents, with exact beneficiary account identifiers (BIC8/11, account/IBAN) and purpose codes consistent with the FX regime for international services/commissions; (ii) Commercial Letters of Credit (UCP 600) issued by the Colombian bank for large cargo/charter transactions or where the counterparty requires documentary payment security; (iii) local COP disbursements using CENIT/ACH Colombia (SEBRA/Axion networks) for domestic drayage, fuel, handling, and sub-agent payments; (iv) all outbound FX operations must be declared to Banco de la República via Formulario 1 (services, commissions) or Formulario 6 (income/profit remittances), supported by the charter agreement, supplier invoice, AWB, insurance certificate, and compliance screening results. Settlement to sanctioned or FATF high-risk counterparties must be pre-cleared by the bank's compliance function.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: COP/USD deliverable FX forwards (over-the-counter with Colombian authorized intermediaries, referencing the TRM)
COP/USD non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) settled in USD, permitted for residents with a demonstrable underlying commercial exposure
COP/USD cross-currency swaps executed with authorized local banks under Superintendencia Financiera supervision
COP/USD European-style currency options written by authorized Colombian intermediaries
COP/USD currency futures listed on the derivatives segment of the Colombian Stock Exchange (BVC) for exchange-traded hedging

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general tax holiday exists for air cargo charter brokers. Limited relief may include the ZOMAC 0% corporate income tax rate for new companies with qualifying small-scale commercial operations in former conflict zones, but freight forwarding is typically excluded unless the actual cargo transport originates in the zone. Deductions are allowed for normal operational expenses, research and technology investments under audited DIAN registration, and certain creative-industry incentives under Law 1955 of 2019, each subject to transaction-level caps.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 110 (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios), filed electronically through the DIAN Sede Electrónica platform using a Colombian digital signature.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; the Colombian tax year is the calendar year.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The return is due during September–October of the following fiscal year according to the DIAN scheduler that uses the last two digits of the NIT. The statutory deadline for balance payment accrues interest from the date determined for the return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue including charter brokerage commissions, air cargo forwarding fees, handling commissions, fuel surcharges, and any ancillary service income recognised under accrual accounting.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Colombian SAS is the taxpayer and must declare worldwide income. A foreign parent cannot file this form unless appointed as legal representative, and the SAS continues to be taxable as a domestic resident entity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible costs and expenses: chartered aircraft leasing costs, landing and overflight charges, ground handling, insurance, staff, marketing, office rent, and interest supported by contracts and invoices.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Intercompany chartered aircraft costs must adhere to arm's length comparables and be documented prior to filing. All payments to related parties, tax-haven intermediaries, and Freight Forward and Cargo Agents abroad must be backed by economic activity in Colombia.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net operating profit after allowed costs, deductions, non-taxable revenues, and tax loss compensation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign head-office general and administrative allocations are not deductible unless actually remitted and causally connected to Colombian-source income. Adjustments must be made to remove expenses booked in the parent company that the SAS never bore.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after treaty limitations and narrow exemptions. For a Colombian charter broker this generally equals the net income except adjustments for specific DTA provisions or foreign-source exemption claims.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A foreign owner without a Colombian permanent establishment cannot elect Colombian exemptions or deductions on behalf of the SAS. The SAS files as a Colombian resident and pays tax on its worldwide income, subject to unilateral foreign tax credits.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Apply the headline 35% corporate income tax rate to the taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm that no allocation artificially shifts Colombian-source income to a tax haven; the DIAN may require detailed revenue reconciliation against foreign reporting if the rate used or exemption claim materially deviates from net accounting income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net tax after withholding tax credits, advance payments (anticipos), and available statutory credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The foreign shareholder must ensure that any remaining tax balance is fully paid, as unpaid dividend WHT and unpaid corporate tax can be pursued against the foreign corporate parent under veil-piercing if fraudulent distribution occurred.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty is 5% of the tax payable per month or fraction of delay, capped at 100% of the tax due, with a minimum sanction of 10 UVT. If no tax is due, the late filing penalty is 0.5% of gross assets or income, whichever is higher. Inaccuracies in the return trigger a 100%–160% penalty on the omitted tax, plus monthly default interest at a confiscatory rate fixed by the Superintendencia Financiera and collection surcharges.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: Dividends paid to non-residents from profits already taxed at the Colombian entity level are subject to a 10% withholding tax. If the distribution exceeds taxed retained earnings and is sourced from untaxed or specially exempt profits, the distribution is subject to an additional 35% withholding tax on the non-taxed portion, in combination with the basic 10% dividend WHT. A DTA may reduce the domestic 10% rate, historically to 0%–5%, depending on the treaty partner.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To apply treaty relief, the beneficial owner must deliver to the Colombian withholding agent before payment: (i) a Certificate of Tax Residence issued by the home country tax authority for the payment year; (ii) a notarised beneficial-owner declaration on DIAN-approved format; (iii) audited financial statements or equivalent evidence proving it is not an artificial conduit; and (iv) a written undertaking to notify subsequent residency changes. The withholding agent must submit the treaty application through DIAN web services and retain the entire file for at least five years for audit.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT is 15% for interest and 15% for royalties paid to non-residents. For interest derived from external debt registered with the Banco de la República, the rate can be 10%. Under DTAs, royalties are commonly reduced to 10–15%, and interest to 10% or 0% if paid to a recognised financial institution. Technical assistance fees sent to a foreign beneficiary attract the 15% statutory rate and may be reduced by treaty only if the technical assistance is actually provided from outside Colombia and the beneficiary is a resident of the treaty country.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File and Master File preparation is required when the Colombian taxpayer’s gross income or gross equity at the end of the previous tax year equals or exceeds 100,000 UVT (approx. COP 4,700 million for tax year 2024). Transactions with related parties below this threshold still must be documented for reasonableness, and an abbreviated transfer-pricing annex applies when cross-border transactions exceed 50,000 UVT. Country-by-Country Reporting applies to multinational groups consolidating more than COP 4 trillion in annual revenues.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: There is no formal Economic Substance Regulations regime. However, DIAN and the Superintendencia de Sociedades apply the doctrines of simulation, sham transaction, abuse of corporate form, and anti-fragmentation to disregard a charter broker that lacks employees, premises, aircraft contracts, bank accounts, commercial invoices, and decision-making in Colombia. A foreign entity claiming treaty relief must show substance in its jurisdiction and pass the OECD/Latin American beneficial owner test; otherwise the dividend, royalty, or interest payment is recharacterised and the WHT benefit is denied with reverse penalty.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion – Underreporting Charter Brokerage Revenue
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Invoicing the SAS's commission through a tax-haven shell company, recording fake overhead expenses, issuing false invoices for non-existent fuel surcharges, or omitting USD wire receipts from Swift/Fedwire transfers except on the audited bank statements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal tax evasion under articles 434A and 434B of the Colombian Criminal Code, as amended by Law 1819 of 2016, carries imprisonment of 48–108 months and fines equal to 20% of the evaded tax. The DIAN may also apply an administrative inexactitude penalty of up to 160% of the omitted tax, plus daily default interest and compulsory collection.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Under Law 1258 of 2008, the corporate veil can be pierced if the SAS is used as an instrument of fraud. Shareholders, sole director, and legal representative who ordered or knew of the evasion become personally liable for the corporate tax debt, face travel bans, submission of passports, and possible extradition arrest in international money-laundering investigations.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Beneficial Ownership – Nominee Shareholders and Hidden Principals
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using a Colombian citizen as nominal S.A.S. shareholder while the non-resident foreign air carrier or broker principal receives all economic benefits without being identified in the company's ownership register or AML compliance (Sarlaft) file.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN may disregard the corporate structure and reallocate the charter and brokerage income to the real beneficiary, applying the 35% corporate tax plus penalty of up to 160%. Under Colombian AML law, failure to identify and report the ultimate beneficial owner to the UIAF is an autonomous administrative offence with fines reaching thousands of UVTs.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and notaries signing false beneficial-ownership documentation commit the criminal offence of falsedad en documento privado, punishable by imprisonment of 5–10 years. Courts may freeze the director's personal assets and impose an Interpol red notice or travel ban if the director leaves the jurisdiction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Manipulation – Intercompany Charter Markups
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying a foreign related-party charter broker an inflated charter rate to shift Colombian taxable income abroad, failing to prepare a comparable analysis, or booking back-to-back soft loans from the parent without arm's length interest or repayment schedule.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN adjusts the transaction to the arm's length price, collecting the 35% income tax on the adjustment, default interest, and transfer-pricing penalties. The penalty for failure to file the required Local/Master File or TP annex can be up to 5% of the transaction value, in addition to the inexactitude penalty on the adjusted income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who personally negotiated or approved the inflated intercompany rates are joint debtors for the tax debt if the SAS was used to defraud creditors. The Superintendencia de Sociedades can impose administrative fines, and criminal liability may arise when fraudulent documentation was used to support the abnormal prices.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Money Laundering and Embargo Violations in Air Cargo Charter
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Chartering aircraft to transport cargo to a sanctioned country, accepting a wire transfer from a politically exposed party without conducting a customer due diligence file, or using shell freight-forwarding agents to obscure the ultimate sender of cargo proceeds from US or UN embargo regimes.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Money laundering under article 323 of the Colombian Criminal Code imposes imprisonment of 9–15 years and a fine of 500 to 50,000 minimum monthly wages for the individuals found criminally responsible. Administrative fines by the UIAF can exceed COP 10,000 million and the Aeronáutica Civil may revoke the required air cargo brokerage licence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A director who authorised the wire transfer or knowingly signed cargo documents participates personally in the offence. Corporate veil protection is expressly unavailable for fraud and gross negligence; the director faces extradition risk, individual bank account sealing, and cancellation of residency if a foreign national.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Repatriation Evasion through Disguised Loans or Fees
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying dividends to a non-resident parent without applying the 10% WHT, while documenting the payment as a repayment of a fake loan, a technical service fee, or an aircraft transit fee, with no genuine underlying transaction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN recharacterises the transaction as a dividend or taxable royalty and collects the avoided withholding tax plus a 100% penalty for fraud or an inexactitude penalty up to 160%. Default interest is computed daily on the unpaid amount from the statutory due date.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The foreign parent's officers who caused the Colombian manager to route payments in a fraudulent manner are liable under Colombian administrative law for unpaid withholding taxes; the Colombian director may be prevented from leaving Colombia through a judicial travel ban and may be personally fined under the company law duties of loyalty and diligence.
